mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment(target_id, target_type, content, member_id, rating) VALUES(#{target_id}, #{target_type}, #{content}, #{member_id}, #{rating})
mapper.select: SELECT c. *, m.nickname FROM comment c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.target_id = #{target_id} AND c.target_type = #{target_type} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.comment_id
